title: •Insignificant Rebellion
caption: •Insignificant Rebellion (V)
game_text: If Ralltiir Operations on table, deploy on table. Ounee Ta is canceled. Your troopers are power = 2. Whenever you deploy a site to Ralltiir, may activate 3 Force. Whenever you draw battle destiny, may exchange a card from hand with a card of the same card type in Lost Pile. {alter}
lore: “Your fleet is lost. And your friends on the Endor moon will not survive. There is no escape, my young apprentice.”

notes: Unique. Banner EFFECT, no grabber box. Red circle-slash A at the end → {alter} (stub expands 'Immune to Alter.'). Lore corrected from scan: curly double quotes (wiki has straight single quotes) — confirmed on the 745 px V10 remake. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright line is the SE-style form with 2000, legible. Modern: V10-D-insignificantrebellion.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 10 remake — a later different (V) text, same art); VB4 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
